name: Gateway YMCA Summer Day Camp, Five Points Branch
description_short: YMCA day camp at the Gateway Family YMCA Five Points Branch in Union for ages 3 and 4 in preschool camp and children entering kindergarten through grade 8, with a sports camp for ages 8 to 13. Weekly sessions mix indoor and outdoor games, sports, arts and STEAM with learning loss prevention activities and swimming.
refund_policy_summary: No refunds or credits if a child does not attend or for absences; the $50 per week deposit is non-refundable.
notes: Rates need a Y membership: $349 per week for a youth program member, $313 for a full member. Traditional camp (K to 8) and preschool camp (ages 3 and 4, toilet trained) at $313 full member or $349 youth program member per week; sports camp July 6 to 21 for ages 8 to 13 at $323 full member or $359 youth program member. Camp 8:30 am to 5 pm. A $50 non-refundable deposit per week goes toward tuition; weeks 1 to 5 are due May 15 and weeks 6 to 10 by June 6. Campers bring lunch and two snacks; the Y provides no food. 4Cs and Program for Parents subsidies accepted. Early bird: pay in full for 5 or more weeks in December to keep the prior year's rate.
